```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(treemapify)
library(colorspace)
library(scales)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

filterResult <- function(result, filt) {

  q <- function(nm) {
    paste0(".data$", nm, " %in% filt[[\"", nm, "\"]]") |>
      rlang::parse_exprs() |>
      rlang::eval_tidy()
  }

  # filter columns
  cols <- c("cdm_name", "variable_name", "variable_level", "estimate_name")
  cols <- cols[cols %in% names(filt)]
  for (nm in cols) {
    result <- dplyr::filter(result, !!!q(nm))
  }

  # filter settings
  cols <- c(
    "result_id", "result_type", "package_name", "package_version",
    "min_cell_count", omopgenerics::settingsColumns(result = result)
  )
  cols <- cols[cols %in% names(filt)]
  for (nm in cols) {
    result <- omopgenerics::filterSettings(result, !!!q(nm))
  }

  # filter group
  cols <- omopgenerics::groupColumns(result = result)
  cols <- cols[cols %in% names(filt)]
  for (nm in cols) {
    result <- omopgenerics::filterGroup(result, !!!q(nm))
  }

  # filter strata
  cols <- omopgenerics::strataColumns(result = result)
  cols <- cols[cols %in% names(filt)]
  for (nm in cols) {
    result <- omopgenerics::filterStrata(result, !!!q(nm))
  }

  # filter additional
  cols <- omopgenerics::additionalColumns(result = result)
  cols <- cols[cols %in% names(filt)]
  for (nm in cols) {
    result <- omopgenerics::filterAdditional(result, !!!q(nm))
  }

  # correct settings
  set <- omopgenerics::settings(result)
  # remove columns that all are NA
  cols <- colnames(set) |>
    purrr::keep(\(x) any(!is.na(x)))
  set <- set |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cols))
  # replace NA for '-NA-'
  set <- set |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      .cols = dplyr::where(is.character),
      .fns = \(x) dplyr::coalesce(x, "-NA-")
    ))

  # final result
  omopgenerics::newSummarisedResult(x = result, settings = set)
}
prepareResult <- function(result, resultList) {
  purrr::map(resultList, \(x) filterResult(result, x))
}
getValues <- function(result, resultList) {
  resultList |>
    purrr::imap(\(x, nm) {
      res <- filterResult(result, x)
      values <- res |>
        dplyr::select(!c("estimate_type", "estimate_value")) |>
        dplyr::distinct() |>
        omopgenerics::splitAll() |>
        dplyr::select(!"result_id") |>
        as.list() |>
        purrr::map(\(x) sort(unique(x)))
      valuesSettings <- omopgenerics::settings(res) |>
        dplyr::select(!dplyr::any_of(c(
          "result_id", "result_type", "package_name", "package_version",
          "group", "strata", "additional", "min_cell_count"
        ))) |>
        as.list() |>
        purrr::map(\(x) sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))) |>
        purrr::compact()
      values <- c(values, valuesSettings)
      names(values) <- paste0(nm, "_", names(values))
      values
    }) |>
    purrr::flatten()
}
getSelected <- function(choices) {
  purrr::imap(choices, \(vals, nm) {
    if (grepl("_denominator_sex$", nm)) {
      if ("Both" %in% vals) return("Both")
      return(vals[[1]])
    }

    if (grepl("_denominator_age_group$", nm)) {
      bounds <- regmatches(vals, regexec("^(\\d+) to (\\d+)$", vals))
      valid <- vapply(bounds, length, integer(1)) == 3
      if (any(valid)) {
        ranges <- vapply(bounds[valid], \(x) as.numeric(x[3]) - as.numeric(x[2]), numeric(1))
        return(vals[valid][[which.max(ranges)]])
      } else {
        return(vals[[1]])
      }
    }

    if (grepl("_outcome_cohort_name$", nm)) {
      return(vals[[1]])
    }

    if ("overall" %in% vals) {
      return("overall")
    }

    vals
  })
}

devices <- read_csv("/Users/ah22023/Documents/GitHub/HERON-UK-02-005-DeviceMapping/shiny/devices.csv")

resultList <- list(
  summarise_omop_snapshot = list(result_type = "summarise_omop_snapshot"),
  summarise_clinical_records = list(result_type = "summarise_clinical_records"),
  summarise_trend = list(result_type = "summarise_trend"),
  summarise_log_file = list(result_type = "summarise_log_file"),
  summarise_table = list(result_type = "summarise_table"),
  summarise_log_sql = list(result_type = "summarise_log_sql") )
```

# GOSH

```{r, fig.width=9,fig.height=7}
#Plot 1

#Step 1
result <- omopgenerics::importSummarisedResult("/Users/ah22023/Documents/GitHub/HERON-UK-02-005-DeviceMapping/shiny/rawData/results_GOSH_OMOP_2026_11_18.csv")
data <- prepareResult(result, resultList)
values <- getValues(result, resultList)
choices <- values
selected <- getSelected(values)

#Step 2
working_data <- data[["summarise_table"]]|> 
  omopgenerics::tidy() |> 
  left_join(devices |> 
              select(!"device_name") |> 
              mutate(device_concept_id = as.character(device_concept_id)),
            by = join_by(cdm_name, device_concept_id,
                         device_concept_id_name, unique_device_id))

#Step 3
working_data |> 
  filter_out(device_concept_id == "0" & is.na(gudid_brand_name)) |> 
  group_by(cdm_name, medical_specialty) |> 
  summarise(total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(area = total_count, fill = medical_specialty, label = medical_specialty)) +
  geom_treemap() +
  geom_treemap_text(
    colour = "white",
    place = "centre",
    grow = TRUE,
    reflow = TRUE ) +
  labs(title = "Counts by Medical Specialty") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(vars(cdm_name))

```

```{r, fig.width=9,fig.height=4}
#Plot 2

#Step 1
specialties <- sort(unique(working_data$medical_specialty))
base_palette <- setNames(hue_pal(l = 65, c = 100)(length(specialties)), specialties)

#Step 2
plot_data <- working_data |>  
  filter_out(device_concept_id == "0" & is.na(gudid_brand_name)) |> 
  group_by(cdm_name, medical_specialty, device_class) |> 
  summarise(total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate( device_class = factor(
      device_class, 
      levels = c("Class I", "Class IIa", "Class IIb", "Class III")    ),
    base_col = base_palette[medical_specialty],
    shade_amount = case_when(
      device_class == "Class I"   ~ -0.35, 
      device_class == "Class IIa" ~ -0.10,
      device_class == "Class IIb" ~  0.15,
      device_class == "Class III" ~  0.40   ),
    tile_fill = darken(base_col, amount = shade_amount) ) 

#Step 3
ggplot(plot_data, aes(
  area = total_count,
  fill = tile_fill,
  subgroup = medical_specialty,
  label = device_class )) +
  geom_treemap(colour = "white", size = 0.8) +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_border(colour = "white", size = 2.5) +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_text(
    place = "topleft",
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "white",
    size = 12 ) +
  geom_treemap_text(
    place = "bottomright",
    colour = "white",
    size = 9,
    reflow = TRUE ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  theme_void() +
  facet_wrap(vars(cdm_name)) 

```
